cues: Impossible...
Why?
Because you tried to go it alone.
You were strong, but you had a fatal flaw.
You trusted nobody.
Our lord fights alongside us as our equal.
And in turn, that makes us all strong.
There's nothing weak about needing one another.
That's right. It's... it's as my lord Shingen used to say,
"The people are your castle, your ramparts, your moat."
Humans... Sentimental...
To the end...
It's over...
ens
event
Orochi has fallen before the might of Cao Cao!
It's over.
Not just yet.
My quest is incomplete.
I must realize my dream.
Your dream?
I always meant to ask you...
Did you think you could realize that dream alone?
You're going to need everyone's help.
You could never break the bonds between us!
Or did you think otherwise?
In fact,
we should thank you for strengthening them!
That's right!
You will be punished for the suffering you have caused!
You are no match for the combined power of the Sun family!
Heh heh... This is just the beginning.
You are right. We are witnessing the beginning.
Indeed.
You guys still haven't had enough?
Hey! Stop fighting already! I mean it!
This is the beginning of a new era...
Hmm.
This is our chance to rebuild!
A new era!
...of glorious war.
